svg.title: Indexed analytic heightfield and its exact grid counts
svg.desc: A heightfield y=0.4 sin(x) cos(z) is sampled on an 8 by 10 rectangular XZ grid with positive Y upward. It has 99 unique referenced vertices, 258 edges, 160 triangle faces, 36 boundary edges and Euler characteristic one. The analytic upward normal is proportional to (-partial h by x,1,-partial h by z). The heightfield cannot represent overhangs.
svg.text: A continuous rule becomes a finite indexed terrain
h(x,z) = 0.4 sin(x) cos(z) metres; world X and Z are horizontal, +Y is up
The terrain's height can change without changing its indexed graph. The green lines show finite sampled edges, not a smooth analytic surface.
